profile.name: Gokula Kannan
about: Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience delivering enterprise solutions across banking, finance, and enterprise domains using OutSystems and modern web technologies.
Specialized in solution architecture, system design, enterprise integrations, performance optimization, data modeling, and technical leadership.
Creator of OutSystems DevTools (React-based Chrome DevTools extension) with proven success in leading pre-production stabilization, mentoring engineering teams, and leading high-impact delivery.

projects.title: Enterprise Digital Platform
projects.blurb: Large-scale OutSystems platform covering UI, integrations, and modular architecture. Led R&D/POCs for Regula, FACEKI, HyperPay and engineered custom Cordova native plugins.

projects.title: OutSystems DevTools
projects.blurb: Chrome-based developer tooling extension for OutSystems applications, rebuilt in React (v3): runtime inspection, React component tree analysis, network monitoring, mock rule engine, client storage & Local DB inspection.

projects.title: Dealer Award Systems
projects.blurb: End-to-end solution architecture and technical implementation for Bentley Motors global dealer recognition and award management platform.

projects.title: First Notice of Loss
projects.blurb: Supervised architecture, data modeling restructuring (53% performance gain), and enhanced interfaces for enterprise insurance claim management handling end-to-end FNOL flows.

bullets: Leading end-to-end architecture and development of the Enterprise Digital Platform — a large-scale OutSystems application covering UI, integrations, and modular components.
Designed scalable, reusable, high-performance front-end modules and full application architecture.
Conducted R&D and POCs for third-party integrations — identity verification (Regula, FACEKI) and payment gateway (HyperPay) — delivering working POCs within 2-week timelines.
Built custom Cordova-based native plugins to integrate external SDKs where no official OutSystems plugins were available, enabling advanced mobile capabilities.
Played a key role in pre-production stabilization — identifying, debugging, and resolving critical issues under high-pressure delivery cycles.
Provided technical guidance and troubleshooting support to team members, improving issue resolution time and overall delivery efficiency.
Collaborated with business, QA, and stakeholders to ensure alignment between requirements, implementation, and timelines.
Documented architecture, implementation approaches, and technical decisions in Confluence for knowledge sharing.
Provided technical leadership and architectural oversight for enterprise solution delivery.
Spearheaded strategic project execution for Bentley Motors — Dealer Award Systems — defining solution architecture and guiding development teams in best-practice technical designs.
Oversaw deployment planning, release management, and post-production support activities.
Mentored development teams to enhance technical competency and delivery efficiency.
Delivered projects within committed timelines while maintaining quality and stakeholder expectations.
Led data model restructuring initiative eliminating duplicate entities and optimizing query architecture — achieving a 53% performance improvement.
Mentored 2 new engineers, accelerating onboarding and overall delivery milestones.
Key contributor to design and implementation of new mobile application features.
Contributed to the First Notice of Loss (FNOL) insurance platform — advising on domain architecture, enhancing interfaces, and supervising implementation.
Delivered Riyad Online (Riyad Bank) — developed user-friendly web forms, optimized web apps for speed, security, and scalability, and created CMS interfaces for clients.
Delivered Riyad Tadawul Market mobile application — converted business requirements into technical solutions, led code review, and managed version control and releases.
Collaborated with project managers, developers, QA, and customers to resolve complex technical issues.
Analyzed proposed technical solutions against customer requirements and recommended best-fit approaches.
Delivered Qualified Candidate Database (QCD) — a recruitment platform with scalable, API-centric infrastructure.
Promoted technical leadership to entry-level and junior engineers in complex enterprise environments.
Designed intuitive UI/UX solutions and coordinated large-scale software deployments.
Developed Color Visualizer Tool and Yellow Stack cloud migration project.
Converted mockups into production-ready web presence using HTML, JavaScript, AJAX, and JSON.
Deployed existing application into cloud environment, integrating auto-scaling, monitoring, and disaster recovery services.
Implemented UI/UX improvements based on customer feedback with post-launch patches.
Built Omdaram (e-commerce), Rapid Serviz (home services platform), and Choyz (online shopping site).
Developed functional databases, applications, and servers; integrated secure payment gateways across all platforms.
Collaborated with engineers to evaluate and improve software and hardware interfaces.
